claims.text: The same document records that Hillenkoetter 'headed the Central Intelligence Agency from May 1947 to October 1950' and that he 'wants a Congressional investigation of the UFOs'. On the wartime and immediate post-war years he is quoted: 'I know that neither Russia nor this country had anything even approaching such high speeds and maneuvers.'

claims.text: A Worcester (Mass.) Gazette clipping of 1 June 1960, held in CIA records, reports Hillenkoetter declaring of the so-called flying saucers: 'The unknown objects are operating under intelligent control. It is imperative that we learn where the UFO's (unidentified flying objects) come from and what their purpose is.'
